dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}. It is because of your help that everyone can enjoy "the taste of happiness" at Festival Utsava.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Festival Utsava...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: The more friends to share the "taste of happiness" with, the better it becomes. So when Festival Utsava comes, I will make sure every Aranara gets to have a "taste of happiness."

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: By then... I think Arapacati will have a good time like everyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the "taste of happiness"...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Besides the "taste of happiness," there is also the "taste of sadness."

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: It's a terrible salty taste, which makes you very sad even with just a small bite.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: But Nara seem to like the "taste of sadness." I don't understand this.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Could it be that sharing the "taste of sadness" feels happy, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: It's the taste of happiness! I can feel the happiness!

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: #Ah, Nara {NICKNAME}! Have you heard of the "taste of anger"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The "taste of anger"?

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: That taste, Nara Varuna once brought it up.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: A taste of it would make you feel as if swallowed the flame of Vanagni. Eeek! Even the thought of it is terrifying.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: But some Nara like that taste. They must be the bravest Nara among all.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: #Brave Nara {NICKNAME} must like "the taste of anger," no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have things to tend to...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Oh... Let Arasaka know when you're all set then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I like it.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Oh, so all brave Nara like the "taste of anger."

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Alright, in the future "special cooking training," I will give the "taste of anger" a try. Hope... it doesn't hurt too much.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't like it.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Hmm... So not every brave Nara likes the "taste of anger"...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: In the future "special cooking training," I will try to find the taste that brave Nara likes.
